scope: All stable requirement IDs in the SPEC corpus. Binding files define current runtime obligations. coverage_scope.classification_rule: Every stable SPEC ID is binding by default unless it appears exactly once in architecture_baseline_requirement_ids or future_backlog_requirement_ids. Explicit future classification overrides textual references from a binding SPEC, including IDs named only to state non-goals. Future backlog may only be PLANNED, BLOCKED or UNAVAILABLE.
